audit_metadata.audit_name: AEIM Diagram 2 — Complete Indicator-by-Indicator Wiring Audit — Strict Live Provenance Verification
audit_metadata.rule: Exactly one final_component_status per component, drawn only from status_enum_authorized. All additional nuance is captured in failure_reason and/or discrepancy_notes, never as a compound status.
audit_metadata.evidence_standard: For any component marked PASS, runtime_evidence must include a real run/trace identifier, function-call evidence, real input, real output, a database or audit record, a downstream consumption event, and the SHA256 of the canonical source file. Scheduler registration, database table existence, or orchestrator/registry references alone are explicitly NOT accepted as runtime execution proof.

A small number (noted per-component in failure_reason) could not be fully evidenced to the PASS bar within this session's time-box and are conservatively marked NOT_EXECUTED_WITH_VALID_TRIGGER_EVIDENCE rather than fabricated as PASS; they are flagged for a targeted follow-up query in the next deliverable phase (diagram2_database_reconciliation.json / diagram2_failures_and_discrepancies.json).

components.claimed_capability: Detects statistically significant price jumps using bipower variation, as part of the Layer 9 Statistical Edge battery.
components.failure_reason: layer9_scores (the scheduled batch scanner's persistence table) has 751 real rows spanning multiple days. Queried this session: 751/751 rows have a non-null `error` column (511 rows = "'<' not supported between instances of 'int' and 'NoneType'"; 240 rows = "The truth value of a DataFrame is ambiguous..."), 0/751 rows have a non-null statistical_score, and jump_detected is false on 751/751 rows. Per source read of compute_layer9_score() (layer9_statistical_edge.py lines 141-314), a populated `error` field and null statistical_score can only occur when the function's outer try block never completes (line 313-314 exception handler returns _SAFE_DEFAULT). This means the scheduled batch path has never once successfully executed the jump-detection sub-routine (jump_detection_bipower) to completion across 751 consecutive real invocations; jump_detected=false is indistinguishable from the hard-coded exception fallback, not a genuine 'no jump' finding.
components.discrepancy_notes: One unrelated live-query prediction (aiem_probability_engine_predictions id=458, ticker MAA) shows a non-default statistical_score=48.32 and regime='trending' from a different call context (aiem_probability_engine/context.py), suggesting the underlying compute_layer9_score() function is not universally broken in every call path. That single data point was not sufficient this session to determine whether the individual jump/hurst/vpin sub-scores are genuinely computed there or are also silently defaulting while only the outer score differs — flagged as an open item for the next audit phase rather than allowed to soften this FAIL, which rests on the fully queried, 100%-reproducible 751-row batch-table evidence.
